messages.subject: Error: argument is of length zero
parts:
I am going to do my first web application with shiny. On the web application if i choose "Hopitaux" and "G. Rawiri", i obtained "Error in if (nrow(layer_data) == 0) return() : argument is of length zero" in R console and no display the graphic. I think that reactive expression " etablInput()" don't work correctly. But i don't know. Please help me.

Server.r

library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)
library(plyr)
library(reshape2)
library(reshape)

data1<-read.csv("Data1.csv")
data1$Mois<-factor(substr(data1$Mois,1,3), levels = substr(month.name,1,3))
data1$Etablissement<-factor(data1$Etablissement, levels = c("Hopital","Dispensaire","Centre de Sante","Infirmerie"))

data2<-read.csv("data2.csv")
data2$Mois<-factor(substr(data2$Mois,1,3), levels = substr(month.name,1,3))
data2$Etablissement<-factor(data2$Etablissement, levels = c("Hopital","Dispensaire","Centre de Sante","Infirmerie"))


shinyServer(function(input, output) {
 
  datasetInput <- reactive({switch(input$Year,"2012"=data1,"2013"=data2)})
 
  malInput<-reactive({switch(input$indic,"Toutes"="^Paludisme|^SIDA|^Grippe|^Tuberculose",'Paludisme'="^Paludisme", 'ViH/Sida'="^SIDA",'Grippe'='^Grippe','Tuberculose'='^Tuberculose')})
 
  etablInput<-reactive({switch(input$etabl1,'A. Schweizter'='Albert SCHWEITZER','G. Rawiri'='Régional')})
 
 
 
  output$plot<-renderPlot({
       if (input$etabl=="Tous"){
         
        
          mal1<-grep(malInput(),datasetInput()[,10])
          data3<-ddply(datasetInput()[mal1,],
                .(Maladie,Mois),summarise,N=sum(Frequence,na.rm=T))
          p1<-ggplot(data=data3,aes(x=data3$Mois, y=data3$N, colour=data3$Maladie,group=data3$Maladie),environment=environment())+
          geom_line()+
          geom_point(size=2, shape=20, colour="blue")+
          xlab("Mois")+ylab("Nombre de cas")+
          labs(colour="Maladie")+theme(legend.position="bottom")+
          theme(legend.background=element_rect(fill="white", colour="black"))
          print(p1)
       
          }
   
    if (input$etabl=="Hopitaux"){
           mal2<-grep(malInput(),datasetInput()[,10])
          eta1<-grep(etablInput(),datasetInput()[,3])
          data3<-ddply(datasetInput()[intersect(mal2,eta1),],
                .(Maladie,Mois),summarise,N=sum(Frequence,na.rm=T))
          p1<-ggplot(data=data3,aes(x=data3$Mois, y=data3$N, colour=data3$Maladie,group=data3$Maladie),environment=environment())+
          geom_line()+
          geom_point(size=2, shape=20, colour="blue")+
          xlab("Mois")+ylab("Nombre de cas")+
          labs(colour="Maladie")+theme(legend.position="bottom")+
          theme(legend.background=element_rect(fill="white", colour="black"))
          print(p1)
       
          }
 
 })
})
